name: EHC Mall export gate
description: Telegram ehcmall: optional before_dispatch export. Default beforeDispatchMode=agent (pass-through). auto-export runs export_tables.py and skips the chat model.

telegramAccountId.description: Only run when ctx.accountId matches (default: ehcmall)

beforeDispatchMode.description: agent (default): export 요청을 대화 LLM+스킬로 넘김(JSON 선별). auto-export: 게이트에서 스크립트만 실행하고 채팅 모델 생략
